text: Marek Barros is wide on the left flank near the halfway line at Harbour City’s attacking end. He crosses the ball into the penalty area, where teammate Ravi Varga leaps to head but is blocked. Barros quickly regains control outside the box about 44 metres from goal and shoots with his foot, sending the ball towards the near right corner of the Seabrook Town goal. The ball goes in, extending Harbour City’s lead to 2-0 early in the second half. [#972] [#973] [#975]
